advertised_reward_stack: Megadrop score and rewards where applicable

accepted_only_if: timestamp-matched BNB Simple Earn principal and status prove the account held the evaluated eligible balance
realized Simple Earn and dividend rows reconcile to account balance changes without double counting
each non-BNB reward is valued at conservative executable sale proceeds available after distribution rather than a later high or announcement price
the frozen equal-base BNBUSDT short funding cash flows are combined with exact account entry exit and rebalancing costs
every seven-day and monthly robustness window remains positive after basis margin liquidation transfer tax custody opportunity and alternative-yield costs
bull bear sideways choppy volatility liquidity and latency stress slices pass or the mechanism abstains
economic_gate.airdrop_value_rule: Use executable post-distribution sale proceeds net of exact account fees and spread. A public token allocation or future price is not per-BNB realized value.
economic_gate.principal_matching_rule: For every reward interval use the lower timestamp-supported eligible BNB principal across the Simple Earn position and reward records; an unknown denominator rejects the interval.
rejection_conditions: any account eligibility principal reward or sale-value interval is unproved
the realized incremental airdrop stack does not clear the frozen hedge-cost hurdle after all costs
a public pool allocation is divided by an assumed eligible BNB denominator
future or maximum token prices are used to value historical distributions
the hedge is opened or BNB is acquired merely to chase an unannounced retroactive snapshot
a failed robustness window is hidden by an aggregate positive result

frozen_hedge_evidence_reuse.reuse_rule: Do not paginate funding again or resample BNB books. Recompute only the new reward-stack economics against this frozen hedge history until materially new execution evidence exists.

mechanism.first_order_direction_neutral_condition: eligible long BNB Simple Earn principal and short BNBUSDT perpetual base quantity remain equal after every reward fee and redemption change
mechanism.name: delta_hedged_bnb_simple_earn_and_airdrop_reward_stack
mechanism.risk_boundary: Equal base quantity removes first-order BNB direction only. Funding basis margin liquidation variable or absent rewards token-sale liquidity account eligibility redemption delay custody tax and opportunity costs remain.

endpoints.evidence: current BNB flexible product rate airdrop rate purchase redemption and sold-out state
current BNB locked projects APR duration quota reward assets and sold-out state
held BNB flexible principal latest rate airdrop rate airdrop asset and cumulative reward fields
held BNB locked principal status dates base and extra reward fields and redemption state
timestamped BNB flexible base bonus realtime and reward distributions
timestamped BNB locked reward distributions bound to position identifiers
all-asset dividend rows with amount asset distribution time transaction identifier and description for realized Launchpool Megadrop HODLer or other distributions
endpoints.pagination_rule: Freeze newest-first non-overlapping windows no wider than 90 days; if total exceeds returned rows or 500 rows are returned stop and redesign narrower windows before any one-use activation.

read_only_account_prequalification.execution_rule: Do not implement or freeze a signed collector while either designated ephemeral credential variable is absent. Once both are present source-bind and hosted-verify a GET-only capture whose windows cover the frozen hedge interval before its one permitted run.
read_only_account_prequalification.redaction_rule: Never serialize headers signatures query strings credential values or secret-derived material.
